name: deen-allah-encyclopedia-api
description: Multilingual Deen Allah Encyclopedia API with source-aware Quran, hadith, tafsir, sirah, fiqh, creed and Tajweed resources.

scripts.test:corpus: node test/corpus_search.test.js && node test/corpus_repository.test.js && node test/corpus_api.integration.test.js && node test/http_server.integration.test.js
scripts.test:ghaib: node test/ghaib-evidence-router.test.js && node test/hadith-evidence-registry.test.js && node test/hadith-scholar-linker.test.js
scripts.rechercher:auto-acquire-plan:
node -e "import('./src/rechercher-auto-acquisition.js').then(async m=>{const fs=await import('node:fs/promises'); const input=process.env.INPUT_PATH ?? 'data/corpus/rechercher/discovered-books.jsonl'; const output=process.env.OUTPUT_PATH ?? 'data/corpus/rechercher/auto-acquisition-plan.jsonl'; const rows=(await fs.readFile(input,'utf8')).split(/?
/).filter(Boolean).map(JSON.parse); await fs.mkdir(output.slice(0,output.lastIndexOf('/'))||'.',{recursive:true}); const plan=m.buildAutoAcquisitionPlan(rows); await fs.writeFile(output,plan.map(JSON.stringify).join('
')+(plan.length?'
':'')); console.log(JSON.stringify({total:plan.length,autoDownload:plan.filter(x=>x.outcome.startsWith('AUTO_DOWNLOAD')).length,readOnly:plan.filter(x=>x.outcome==='READ_ONLY_OR_LINK_ONLY').length,output},null,2));})"
